rows.en: Um, excuse me. Please return quickly.
Finishing it safely? How good of you.
As expected, you're a klutz. Useless.
You came back alive? That's a surprise.
Hm? Did you say something?
You call that taking it seriously? Honestly.
You have the devil's own luck. I mean that as praise.
I thought you'd be a bit more useful than that.
Oh? You didn't run away. Impressive.
Don't get too carried away just because you succeeded.
It all ended safely. A miracle, maybe?
Anyway, it's over.
That's all you amount to.
Don't think this kind of luck will last.
Good work. You can stand down now.
It's over. Good work.
Mission complete. Return to base.
Mission accomplished. You did well, for you.
Mission over. Return immediately.
Mission over. Return to base.
I'm so glad you're safe.
Quite some skill. Keep it up.
Glad you made it back safe.
Looks like it's over. Good work.
You're safe, right? Good work.
Good work. Get some solid rest for the next one.
Glad it all ended safely. Good work.
I'm counting on you next time too.
All right, rest up for the next one.
Looks like it's over. You can come back now.
Good work. You had me a little worried, honestly.
Well done. You did better than I imagined.
With your skill, of course you'd succeed.
Not bad skill. I like it.
Thanks for sortieing, it helped. I'm counting on you again.
You handled that mission brilliantly.
You looked cool. You're a full-fledged pilot now.
Pretty skillful. I'm praising you honestly, so be happier.
Heh, keep it up next time too.
You did your best. Good work.
Now, hurry back. I'll be waiting.
You worried me a little. Take responsibility.
Good work. You did follow my orders properly.
You did well. I can tell.
Impressive skill. I'm counting on you next time too.
Amazing. Is this what an ace can do?
Worrying me this much... you really are a handful.
What is this feeling? Being with you makes me so nervous.
Leaving this mission to you was the right call after all.
You're safe. I'll treat you to tea later.
Oh, it's over. Thank goodness.
I'll have to give you a reward for your performance.
Hey! If you're free after this, go on a d-date with me!
No need to worry after all. You're dependable.
Hee hee, impressive. You're not captain for nothing.
Now then, let's have a party to celebrate! Um, just the two of us...
Have a drink with me when you get back. You can't refuse, of course.
I'm bad at cooking, but I want to make something for you, nya... I didn't bite my tongue!
Good work. Let me buy you a drink today.
I felt you would protect me. Absolutely.
Um, could you start the mission?
I'm counting on you to fight hard.
rows.notes: Heard 'funsou no tatakai' (conflict battle); probably 'funtou' (hard fighting) wo onegai suru wa.

rows.en: Just work as well as a klutz can.
Don't get in the way.
Operation start. Refrain from rash actions.
I'll be in trouble if you don't do it properly.
The mission is starting, so focus.
Who knows how far someone like you can get.
Quit dawdling and start the mission already!
Oh, you're sortieing too?
I don't think it's a difficult mission, but...
Try to handle a mission this easy.
This'll be rough, with skills like yours.
You won't fail a mission this easy, right?
Don't presume on being a woman. Get the mission done.
Mission start. Good luck.
The mission is starting. Don't let your guard down.
The mission's starting. Don't let your guard down.
All right, begin the mission.
Operation start. I pray for your success.

row 722: sarcastic praise (Claire calls the pilot a good boy or girl)
